name: Yatsuse Yoshiki
source:
Brutally critical of others and quick to abruptly end conversation when it fails to suit his concerns, the vagabond Yoshiki possesses intimate knowledge of Kurehito's darkest secret and the unusual atrocities surrounding them. There are signs he has a special relationship with [url=/c4734]Yamiko[/url], but what history they share is not immediately known to [url=/c4736]Kyouji[/url].

[From Eroge Review]
